description: This Perl module defines a Catalyst controller for handling user email change requests, including initiating email change, verifying tokens, canceling changes, and redirecting.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Settings::ChangeEmail
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class managing the email change process, including request handling, verification, cancellation, and redirection.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method setting up the base for change email routes.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Handles the initial email change request, validates input, creates a token, and sends verification emails.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies the provided token and prepares for email change confirmation.

methods.name: post_verify
methods.description: Completes the email change after token verification, updating user email.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing email change process, reverting any pending changes.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs redirection to the account settings page.
